column1: # RAW CAPTURE — Official club depth charts, 2026 Week 10
# Method: each club's own official depth-chart page was loaded and the position
#         tables transcribed in the order the club published them. No value was
#         inferred; where a club published no name at a slot, the field is left
#            P1 = first string (starter), P2..P4 = second/third/fourth string
#            Two names joined by " & " = the club published them as co-starters
#            at the same string (e.g. "Chase Young & Carl Granderson").
#            UNVERIFIED_BLANK = the club published an empty first-string slot.
